concept: τ 파일럿 2호 — 신 파이프라인(F1~F5, 재설계 v1) 매칭 산출 SP 조립 인스트루멘탈. kee 2호 GO 조건 4 반영(공백라벨 1곡 모수분리·Y율≥5/9·앵커Y 필수·문항 2개 SPEC)
assembly_rule: 1호 준용 — 매처 산출 표현만(top-3 매칭곡 네이티브 SP 문장), 창작 보정 금지, 보컬 문장 제외, 템포·키=top1(F1 모드일치·F2 ±10% 보장), 브라켓 lyrics 우회
success_criteria: 공백라벨 제외 9곡 중 Y≥5 + 고스코어 앵커 3곡 중 Y 필수(재붕괴 시 즉시 중단)

songs.title: TAU16 떠오르는 잔향
songs.sp: K-Indie acoustic ballad. A single steel-string acoustic guitar performs a fingerstyle arrangement with steady thumb-plucked bass notes on the downbeats and syncopated melodic fills. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing a steady eighth-note pattern with occasional percussive slaps on the strings. A clean electric guitar provides ambient melodic fills and subtle slides in the background. A nylon-string acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with prominent bass notes and steady arpeggiation. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of E Major.

songs.original: Cinema Paradiso (Love Theme) — Ennio Morricone (Film Score / OST)
songs.title: TAU17 오래된 영사기
songs.sp: K-Pop Ballad. A clean acoustic guitar plays arpeggiated chords in the intro and verses. A grand piano enters with sustained chords and melodic fills. Orchestral strings provide legato accompaniment. The bass guitar plays melodic lines with a warm, rounded tone. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of E Major.

songs.original: River Flows in You — Yiruma (Lo-fi / Neo-classical / Piano)
songs.title: TAU18 흐르는 건반
songs.sp: The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated textures in the background. Acoustic piano plays a steady quarter-note rhythm with occasional melodic flourishes in the upper register. A clean electric guitar provides sparse, palm-muted rhythmic accents and subtle arpeggios. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. Key of D major modulating to F major on the climax chorus.

songs.original: Mercy, Mercy, Mercy — Cannonball Adderley Quintet (Jazz)
songs.title: TAU19 오후의 그루브
songs.sp: K-Pop Indie Pop with a light funk influence. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic patterns and staccato chords. A melodic electric bassline moves in eighth notes, locking with a tight, dry drum kit featuring a crisp snare and subtle hi-hat embellishments. A subtle acoustic piano provides harmonic support in the background. Clean electric guitar leads with a warm, rounded tone perform melodic lines and syncopated chordal stabs. The track is in the key of E Major at 95 BPM in 4/4 time.

songs.title: TAU20 새벽 도시의 맥박
songs.sp: UK Drill. Features a dark, atmospheric piano melody playing minor chords in a syncopated rhythm. A sliding 808 bass provides the melodic low end with long glides between notes. A distant, high-pitched siren sample and atmospheric pads create a cinematic urban texture. Roland TB-303 bassline with high resonance and automated filter cutoff sweeps. 140 BPM, D minor.

songs.title: TAU21 반복의 축적
songs.sp: K-Pop Ballad. A clean acoustic guitar plays arpeggiated chords in the intro and verses. A grand piano enters with sustained chords and melodic fills. Orchestral strings provide legato accompaniment. The bass guitar plays melodic lines with a warm, rounded tone. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of E Major.

songs.title: TAU22 잔잔한 파문
songs.sp: The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A legato string section provides harmonic density with slow-moving pads. The bass is a warm, sub-heavy synth pad that follows the root notes of the piano. Grand piano plays sustained chords and melodic fills. The tempo is 72 BPM in the key of C major.

songs.original: Time — Hans Zimmer (Inception OST) (Film Score / OST)
songs.title: TAU23 느린 상승
songs.sp: Cinematic orchestral score. Solo cello performs a melancholic, legato melody in the tenor register. Sustained string pads in the violins and violas provide harmonic support with slow, gradual volume swells. A secondary cello or double bass enters later to provide low-frequency root notes. The arrangement is sparse and minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the solo cello and the ensemble textures. 65 BPM. D minor.

songs.title: TAU24 사막의 산책
songs.sp: K-Hip Hop track featuring a male rapper with a laid-back, rhythmic flow. The beat is built around a jazzy, sampled piano loop playing minor seventh chords and a syncopated boom-bap drum pattern. A melodic electric bass follows the kick drum with occasional slides. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and reverb. A sub-heavy synth bass provides melodic movement in the low end. The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of C minor.

songs.original: Summer — Joe Hisaishi (Kikujiro OST) (Film Score / OST)
songs.title: TAU25 초록 바람
songs.sp: Folk-pop instrumental featuring a lead violin and acoustic guitar. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar pattern in 4/4 time at 115 BPM in the key of G Major. A violin performs the primary melody using a mix of legato bowing and occasional double stops. A second acoustic guitar provides rhythmic strumming and harmonic support. The bass is provided by a double bass playing root notes on the downbeats. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar pattern in 4/4 time at 115 BPM in the key of G Major.
